blocks.text: Exercises: sentences from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR) and from the library's public-domain books.

exercises.q: Несмотря на ___ (ранний час, acc. sg.), было уже жарко.
exercises.why: **час → час** (acc. sg.). Masculine, inanimate, nominative singular in a consonant. Declines like DLI's дом — every singular form has the same endings (A. sg. дом). No change of ending: here the accusative is the same as the nominative.  **ранний → ранний** (acc. sg. m., agreeing with час). Adjective type II, soft — declines like DLI's синий (every form has the same endings): A. anim. = G., inan. = N. No change of ending: here the accusative is the same as the nominative.  Declension: sg. час · часа · часу · час · часом · часе; pl. часы · часов · часам · часы · часами · часах.  «The accusative of masculine animate nouns is the same as the genitive. The accusative of masculine inanimate nouns and of all neuter nouns is the same as the nominative.» — DLI, Lesson 32.  «All adjectives agree in gender, number and case with the noun they modify.» — DLI, Lesson 47.  Adjectives in the accusative: animate = genitive, inanimate = nominative (masculine and plural); feminine -ую, -юю. — DLI, Lessons 46–47.  — Model words and rules from the DLI Grammar Reference Book; forms from the OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: Какая правда наружу вышла в ___ (эта неделя, acc. sg.)?
exercises.why: **неделя → неделю** (acc. sg.). Feminine, nominative singular in -я. Declines like DLI's неделя — every singular form has the same endings (A. sg. неделю). Ending -я → -ю.  **этот → эту** (acc. sg. f., agreeing with неделю). «этот» is a pronoun-type word with its own declension, not the regular adjective pattern, so no ending rule is claimed. Its forms (f. sg.): эта · этой · этой · эту · этой · этой.  Declension: sg. неделя · недели · неделе · неделю · неделей · неделе; pl. недели · недель · неделям · недели · неделями · неделях.  «The accusative singular of all feminine nouns ending in -ь is the same as nominative. The accusative singular of all other feminine nouns ends in -у or -ю.» — DLI, Lesson 33.  «All adjectives agree in gender, number and case with the noun they modify.» — DLI, Lesson 47.  — Model words and rules from the DLI Grammar Reference Book; forms from the OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: На ___ (четвёртые сутки, acc. pl.) после этого — я ушёл из дома.
exercises.why: **сутки → сутки** (acc. pl.). A plural-only noun (it has no singular); nominative plural сутки. No change of ending: here the accusative is the same as the nominative.  **четвёртый → четвёртые** (acc. pl., agreeing with сутки). Adjective type I, hard — declines like DLI's новый (every form has the same endings): A. anim. = G., inan. = N. No change of ending: here the accusative is the same as the nominative.  Declension (plural only): сутки · суток · суткам · сутки · сутками · сутках.  «The accusative plural of inanimate nouns is the same as the nominative plural. The accusative plural of animate nouns is the same as the genitive plural.» — DLI, Lesson 42.  «The letter ы never follows г, к, х, ж, ч, ш, щ; therefore: книга — книги, река — реки, госпожа — госпожи.» — DLI, Lesson 23.  «All adjectives agree in gender, number and case with the noun they modify.» — DLI, Lesson 47.  «Notice that the adjectives of the "soft", "guttural" and "sibilant" types are declined in the plural in the very same way.» — DLI, Lesson 48. exercises.q: За ___ (такая минута, acc. pl.) ненавидят десять лет, мстят всю жизнь.
exercises.why: **минута → минуты** (acc. pl.). Feminine, inanimate; nominative plural минуты. Declines like DLI's газета — every plural form has the same endings (A. pl. газеты). Ending -а → -ы.  **такой → такие** (acc. pl., agreeing with минуты). Adjective type III, guttural (after г, к, х) — declines like DLI's русский (every form has the same endings, apart from the masculine nominative singular (and the inanimate accusative equal to it), which ends in -ой here, not -ий): A. anim. = G., inan. = N. No change of ending: here the accusative is the same as the nominative.  Declension: sg. минута · минуты · минуте · минуту · минутой · минуте; pl. минуты · минут · минутам · минуты · минутами · минутах.  «The accusative plural of inanimate nouns is the same as the nominative plural. The accusative plural of animate nouns is the same as the genitive plural.» — DLI, Lesson 42.  «All adjectives agree in gender, number and case with the noun they modify.» — DLI, Lesson 47.  «Masculine adjectives of the "hard" and "guttural" types have in the nominative the ending -ой if stressed: новый — молодой; русский — плохой, and retain the stress on the ending throughout the declension.» «The adjective «большой» belongs to the guttural type, in spite of its -ш-: большого, большому, большим, о большом.» — DLI, Lesson 47.  «Notice that the adjectives of the "soft", "guttural" and "sibilant" types are declined in the plural in the very same way.» — DLI, Lesson 48.  Adjectives in the accusative: animate = genitive, inanimate = nominative (masculine and plural); feminine -ую, -юю. — DLI, Lessons 46–47.  — Model words and rules from the DLI Grammar Reference Book; forms from the OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).
